record.title: Turán’s conjecture for the complete 3-graph on four vertices
record.statement:
Let $K_4^{(3)}$ denote the complete $3$-graph on $4$ vertices, and let $\\operatorname{ex}(n,F)$ be the maximum number of edges in a $k$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices containing no subgraph isomorphic to the forbidden $k$-graph $F$. The conjecture is
\[
\operatorname{ex}\!\left(n,K_4^{(3)}\right)=\left(\frac{5}{9}+o(1)\right)\binom{n}{3}.
\]

record.statement:
